subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Planejar e produzir, em colaboração com os colegas e com a ajuda do professor, entrevistas, curiosidades, dentre outros gêneros do campo investigativo, que possam ser repassados oralmente por meio de ferramentas digitais, em áudio ou vídeo, considerando a situação comunicativa e o tema/assunto/finalidade do texto.

components.description_pt: Identificar o propósito comunicativo de gêneros investigativos orais como entrevistas e matérias de curiosidade
components.description_en: Identify the communicative purpose of oral investigative genres such as interviews and curiosity pieces
components.cc_component_description: Identify the purpose of information presented in visual, quantitative, or oral media formats

components.description_pt: Planejar uma entrevista ou matéria de curiosidade colaborativamente, considerando o público e tema
components.description_en: Plan an interview or curiosity piece collaboratively, considering audience and topic
components.cc_component_description: Plan writing by considering purpose, audience, and the most significant ideas to convey

components.description_pt: Produzir um texto investigativo oral usando ferramentas de áudio ou vídeo digital com apoio de colegas e professor
components.description_en: Produce an oral investigative text using digital audio or video tools with peer and teacher support
components.cc_component_description: Use technology tools, with adult guidance, to produce and publish a piece of writing

components.description_pt: Adaptar linguagem e conteúdo para apresentação oral através de formatos digitais
components.description_en: Adapt language and content to suit oral delivery through digital formats
components.cc_component_description: Adapt the organization, style, and substance of a presentation to suit its purpose and audience

cc_matches.description: Analyze the purpose of information presented in diverse media and formats (e.g., visually, quantitatively, orally) and evaluate the motives (e.g., social, commercial, political) behind its presentation.
With guidance and support from adults, use technology to produce and publish writing (using keyboarding skills) as well as to interact and collaborate with others.
Develop and strengthen writing as needed by planning, revising, editing, rewriting, or trying a new approach, focusing on addressing what is most significant for a specific purpose and audience.

Present information, findings, and supporting evidence, conveying a clear and distinct perspective, such that listeners can follow the line of reasoning, alternative or opposing perspectives are addressed, and the organization, development, substance, and style are appropriate to purpose, audience, and a range of formal and informal tasks.
